sources.title: PowerFlex 520-Series Adjustable Frequency AC Drive User Manual
sources.page_mapping: Reviewed printed page numbers equal the one-based PDF page numbers: 13, 78, 79, 134, 145, 159, 160, 161.
sources.applicability: PowerFlex 525; identify installed model/version and confirm applicable source before operational use. The manual also covers other 520-Series equipment.

claims.statement: F004 identifies DC-bus undervoltage; F005 identifies DC-bus overvoltage.
claims.qualification: These fault meanings alone do not diagnose a failed component.

claims.statement: A reported F004/F005 sequence does not establish a single cause or prove a faulty component.
claims.qualification: Inference from the distinct conditions and several OEM investigation paths; not an OEM field diagnosis.

claims.statement: Use qualified personnel, site isolation rules and full applicable OEM electrical procedures; a display state is not isolation.
claims.qualification: Editorial notice is not a replacement for the complete OEM/site procedure or restart authorization.

claims.statement: b007/F651 identify the newest recorded code and bus snapshot; b008/F652 identify the previous recorded entry.
claims.qualification: Pair by the stored index and actual code. F652 belongs to F004 only when b008 shows F004; an intervening fault changes the pairing.
The note does not invent a deduplication interval or call this a complete event log.

claims.statement: The stored bus snapshots use filtered b005 data.
claims.qualification: They are not a high-speed waveform or a guarantee that an event peak was captured. No numeric trip threshold is inferred from the display range.

claims.statement: Record machine state, observed disturbances/changes and available diagnostic evidence.
claims.qualification: Evidence collection guidance; no instruction for live measurement or parameter modification.

claims.statement: OEM investigation paths include low incoming voltage or interrupted power for F004 and high line/transients or motor regeneration for F005.
claims.qualification: Potential paths only; the reader's actual cause remains unknown.

claims.statement: Manual clearing follows addressing and correcting the cause; Type 1 does not remove the general requirement.
claims.qualification: No enabling steps or automatic-restart parameter settings are provided.

claims.statement: Automatic fault clearing/restart depends on configuration; clearing without restart is documented.
claims.qualification: Clearing, corrected cause and permission to restart are separate decisions.

claims.statement: Unresolved or repeated faults and work beyond authorization warrant a handoff with identity, records, context and unknowns.
claims.qualification: Practical editorial handoff guidance, not a manufacturer-issued repair procedure.

claims.statement: The image is an AI-generated editorial illustration with a generic drive.
claims.qualification: It does not depict a verified PowerFlex525 configuration, actual measurements, a customer case or a tested product result.

claims.statement: This is an AI-assisted editorial draft with no hardware test or MIRA case result claimed.
claims.qualification: The invitation to discuss manuals makes no claim of demonstrated product behavior.
